Skip to main content Copper 101 Playbooks Setup & Customize Import & Export Data Working with Lists Working with Pipelines Email Features & Tools Automate Tasks & Workflows Forms Managing Users Reports Integrations Settings and permissions Subscription and billing Certified service partners Data and privacy Troubleshooting Product updates API Keys can be used to create, read, update, and delete data in Copper. Only Admin users are able to generate API Keys. To generate an API Key... Navigate to Settings > Integrations > API Keys. Click the 'Generate API Key' button. Once your API Key is produced, you'll be able to see when it was generated and give it a label to differentiate its usage from other API Keys you may generate in the future. ​ This page will only show API Keys you've generated; each Admin user can generate their own. You can delete an API key at any time by clicking the trash can icon at the right: We also have API documentation available for more advanced users. ​ Note: For the Zapier integrations, please go to 'Settings' > 'Integrations,' and generate a token there.
